title: RefRoute: Decoupling Conditioning Cost from References via Compact Residual Conditioning and Spatial Routing
title_zh: RefRoute：通过紧凑残差条件化与空间路由，将条件化成本与参考图像解耦

paragraphs.en: Multi-reference image generation requires preserving the appearance of multiple subjects while composing them into a coherent scene. However, existing diffusion transformers commonly encode references as dense visual token grids and jointly process them with global attention, making conditioning increasingly expensive as the number and resolution of references grow. We present RefRoute , a framework that addresses both reference representation cost and attention overhead through two complementary mechanisms. Compact residual conditioning combines low-resolution latent tokens with lightweight residual features extracted from full-resolution pixels, reducing reference token counts while retaining fine-grained appearance cues. Condition routing and attention routing align reference tokens with their assigned target regions and restrict cross-reference interactions, while allowing selective reference access beyond region boundaries for scene integration. We further introduce RefRoute-Data for training many-reference generation models and ManyRef100 , a benchmark spanning human, object, and mixed compositions with 10–17 references. After many-reference fine-tuning, RefRoute achieves an overall Weighted-Ref-VIEScore of 36.06 on ManyRef100, compared with 8.88 for FLUX.2-Klein-9B. Separate inference-cost evaluations show substantially slower latency growth as the reference count increases: at 16 references, our 50-step and 4-step configurations achieve 18.3 × 18.3\times and 14.2 × 14.2\times speedups over their corresponding FLUX baselines, respectively. These results establish compact reference representations and spatially routed attention as an effective approach to scalable many-reference image generation.
paragraphs.zh: 多参考图像生成需要在将多个主体组合成连贯场景的同时，保留它们的外观特征。 然而，现有的扩散变换器通常将参考信息编码为密集的视觉令牌网格，并通过全局注意力机制联合处理这些令牌，导致参考信息的数量和分辨率增加时，条件约束的计算成本也会随之急剧上升。 我们提出了 RefRoute——一个通过两种互补机制解决参考表示成本和注意力开销问题的框架。 紧凑残差条件约束将低分辨率潜在令牌与从全分辨率像素中提取的轻量级残差特征相结合，在保留精细外观线索的同时减少了参考令牌的总数。 条件路由和注意力路由将参考令牌与其分配的目标区域对齐，并限制跨参考区域的交互，同时允许在区域边界之外选择性地访问参考信息以实现场景整合。 我们还引入了用于训练多参考生成模型的 RefRoute-Data，以及 ManyRef100——一个涵盖人物、物体和混合构图的多参考基准数据集，包含 10 至 17 个参考信息。 经过多参考微调后，RefRoute 在 ManyRef100 数据集上取得了 36.06 的加权参考 VIEScore（Weighted-Ref-VIEScore），而 FLUX.2-Klein-9B 的得分仅为 8.88。 单独进行的推理成本评估显示，随着参考信息数量的增加，延迟增长显著减缓：在 16 个参考信息的情况下，我们的 50 步和 4 步配置分别比对应的 FLUX 基线模型实现了 18.3 × 18.3\times 和 14.2 × 14.2\times 的速度提升。 这些结果表明，紧凑的参考表示和空间路由注意力是一种实现可扩展多参考图像生成的有效方法。

As illustrated in Fig. 1 , a single generation may require several references to preserve the appearance of different entities while placing them at specified locations. This setting raises a fundamental efficiency question: How should the cost of conditioning scale as the number of references increases?

paragraphs.en: Current multimodal diffusion transformers largely answer this question by concatenation. Each reference image is encoded into a dense visual token grid, and the resulting reference tokens are appended to text and noisy target tokens in a unified attention sequence [ Tan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2026 ] . If each reference contributes n n tokens and the target contains N g N_{g} tokens, joint attention has complexity O ⁡ ( ( N g + K ​ n ) 2 ) O\left((N_{g}+Kn)^{2}\right) , where K K is the number of references. For example, a 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 reference produces 4096 visual tokens, making multiple references ( K > 1 K>1 ) quickly dominate the input sequence. This reveals two distinct sources of unnecessary computation .
paragraphs.zh: 当前的多模态扩散变换器主要通过拼接方式来回答这个问题。 每张参考图像都被编码为密集的视觉令牌网格，生成的参考令牌随后被附加到文本和含噪目标令牌中，形成一个统一的注意力序列 [ Tan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2026 ]。 如果每张参考图像贡献 n 个令牌，而目标包含 N_g 个令牌，则联合注意力的计算复杂度为 O((N_g + Kn)^2)，其中 K 是参考图像的数量。 例如，一张 1024×1024 的参考图像会产生 4096 个视觉令牌，这使得多个参考图像（K > 1）会迅速主导输入序列。 这揭示了两种不同的不必要计算来源。

paragraphs.en: Representation scaling. A dense reference representation allocates tokens according to the number and resolution of input references. Yet the information required for generation does not necessarily grow with its references. Simply reducing the reference resolution decreases token count, but can discard precisely the high-frequency cues needed for faithful reconstruction [ Medi et al., 2026 ] . The challenge is therefore not merely to compress a reference, but to construct a bounded representation that preserves generation-relevant appearance information .
paragraphs.zh: 表示缩放。 密集参考表示会根据输入参考的数量和分辨率来分配标记。 然而，生成所需的信息并不一定随着参考数量的增加而增长。 单纯降低参考分辨率可以减少标记数量，但可能会丢弃恰恰是忠实重建所必需的高频线索 [ Medi et al., 2026 ]。 因此，挑战不仅在于压缩参考，更在于构建一种有界表示，以保留与生成相关的外观信息。

paragraphs.en: Interaction scaling. Even after reducing the representation size, standard concatenation leaves the attention graph dense: every target token can interact with every reference token, and reference tokens from different entities can interact with one another. The model must therefore learn implicitly which reference controls which target region. As K K grows, this unrestricted interaction creates unnecessary computation and increases the opportunity for attribute–subject misassociation, identity leakage, and spatial confusion [ Chen et al., 2026a ; Oshima et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ] . Spatial correspondence should instead be represented explicitly in the computation graph: a reference should primarily communicate with the region it is responsible for, rather than with the entire canvas.
paragraphs.zh: 交互扩展。 即使减小了表示大小，标准的拼接方式仍会使注意力图保持密集：每个目标标记都能与所有参考标记交互，而来自不同实体的参考标记之间也能相互交互。 因此，模型必须隐式地学习哪些参考控制着哪些目标区域。 随着 K 的增长，这种无限制的交互会产生不必要的计算量，并增加属性与主体错配、身份泄露和空间混淆的风险 [ Chen et al., 2026a ; Oshima et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ]。 相反，空间对应关系应在计算图中显式表示：一个参考应主要与其负责的区域进行通信，而不是与整个画布通信。

paragraphs.en: These observations suggest a simple design principle: Conditioning should scale with the information and spatial support required by the output, rather than with the resolution and global connectivity of the inputs. Achieving this principle requires solving representation and interaction scaling together. A compact representation alone does not prevent all references from attending globally; spatial masking alone does not prevent the reference token count from growing with input resolution. RefRoute addresses both bottlenecks with two coupled mechanisms: compact residual conditioning and condition/attention routing .
paragraphs.zh: 这些观察结果揭示了一个简单的设计原则：条件化应随输出所需的信息和空间支持而扩展，而非随输入的分辨率和全局连通性而扩展。 要实现这一原则，需要同时解决表示和交互的扩展问题。 仅靠紧凑的表示无法阻止所有引用进行全局关注；仅靠空间掩码也无法阻止引用标记的数量随输入分辨率的增长而增加。 RefRoute 通过两种耦合机制解决了这两个瓶颈：紧凑的残差条件化和条件/注意力路由。

paragraphs.en: Compact residual conditioning. We assign every reference a fixed token budget independent of its resolution. Specifically, a 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 reference is reduced from a 64 × 64 64\times 64 latent grid (4096 tokens) to a 16 × 16 16\times 16 grid (256 tokens). This makes the representation cost independent of the reference resolution. However, the compact latent alone loses fine appearance information. We therefore introduce a lightweight Pixel Residual Compressor that extracts complementary information directly from the original pixels and injects it into the first DiT layer. The resulting representation, H ref = H lr + P ⁡ ( r ) , H^{\mathrm{ref}}=H^{\mathrm{lr}}+P(r), combines the efficiency of a fixed-size latent representation with a residual pathway for high-frequency appearance cues. Because attention complexity depends on the total sequence length, this changes the reference-dependent attention cost by roughly 70 × 70\times at K = 16 K=16 , ignoring text tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 紧凑的残差条件化。 我们为每个参考分配一个与其分辨率无关的固定令牌预算。 具体来说，一个 1024 × 1024 的参考会从 64 × 64 的潜在网格（4096 个令牌）缩减到 16 × 16 的网格（256 个令牌）。 这使得表示成本与参考分辨率无关。 然而，仅靠紧凑的潜在表示会丢失精细的外观信息。 因此，我们引入了一种轻量级的像素残差压缩器，直接从原始像素中提取互补信息，并将其注入到第一个 DiT 层中。 由此得到的表示 H ref = H lr + P ⁡ ( r ) 结合了固定尺寸潜在表示的高效性，以及用于高频外观线索的残差路径。 由于注意力复杂度取决于总序列长度，在 K = 16 时，忽略文本令牌的情况下，这将使依赖参考的注意力成本大约增加 70 倍。

paragraphs.en: Condition and attention routing. Compact references still need to be associated with the correct target instances. RefRoute therefore makes this correspondence explicit. We align each reference with its assigned target region by remapping its rotary positional coordinates. Structured attention then blocks direct interactions between distinct references and lets target queries within each assigned region access the corresponding reference. Outside assigned regions, each target query can access the highest-ranked reference, retaining all tokens of that reference. This selective access allows reference information to influence the surrounding scene, supporting effects such as shadows and reflections while limiting global reference interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 条件与注意力路由。 紧凑的引用仍需与正确的目标实例关联。 因此，RefRoute 使这种对应关系显性化。 我们通过重新映射旋转位置坐标，将每个引用与其分配的目标区域对齐。 结构化注意力随后会阻止不同引用之间的直接交互，并允许每个分配区域内的目标查询访问对应的引用。 在分配区域之外，每个目标查询可以访问排名最高的引用，并保留该引用的所有标记。 这种选择性访问使引用信息能够影响周围场景，从而支持阴影和反射等效果，同时限制全局的引用交互。

paragraphs.en: We introduce RefRoute-Data and ManyRef100 to support training and evaluation of many-reference generation. After many-reference fine-tuning, RefRoute achieves an overall Weighted-Ref-VIEScore of 36.06 on ManyRef100, compared with 8.88 for FLUX.2-Klein-9B. Separate inference-cost evaluations show 18.3 × 18.3\times and 14.2 × 14.2\times speedups at 16 references over the corresponding FLUX baselines at 50 and four sampling steps, respectively. These results demonstrate improved many-reference composition and computational scaling, with a quality trade-off on the predominantly few-reference MICo-Bench.

paragraphs.en: We introduce compact residual conditioning , which combines low-resolution latent tokens with pixel-derived residual features to reduce reference token counts while retaining fine-grained appearance cues.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了紧凑残差条件化方法，该方法将低分辨率潜在标记与源自像素的残差特征相结合，在保留精细外观线索的同时减少参考标记的数量。

paragraphs.en: We propose condition and attention routing , which makes reference–region correspondence explicit through positional alignment and structured attention, with selective reference access beyond assigned regions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了条件与注意力路由机制，该机制通过位置对齐和结构化注意力明确参考区域之间的对应关系，并支持在指定区域之外选择性地访问参考信息。

paragraphs.en: We construct RefRoute-Data with aligned reference–instance–spatial annotations and ManyRef100 , a benchmark covering human, object, and mixed compositions with 10–17 references per case, to support training and systematic evaluation of many-reference generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 RefRoute-Data，该数据集包含对齐的参考–实例–空间标注，以及 ManyRef100——一个涵盖人类、物体和混合构图的数据集，每个案例包含 10–17 个参考，旨在支持多参考生成的训练与系统性评估。

paragraphs.en: Multi-Reference Controllable Generation. Recent diffusion transformers [ Peebles & Xie, 2023 ] incorporate visual conditions by encoding reference images into latent tokens and combining them with text and noisy target tokens [ Tan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Mao et al., 2025 ] . Multi-reference methods extend this design by concatenating multiple reference-token blocks [ Wei et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Mou et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ] . Other works study combinations of reference images with spatial layouts, masks, and poses [ Xiao et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Mou et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025a ; She et al., 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 多参考可控生成。 近期的扩散变换器 [ Peebles & Xie, 2023 ] 通过将参考图像编码为潜在标记，并将其与文本和含噪目标标记相结合，从而融入视觉条件 [ Tan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Mao et al., 2025 ]。 多参考方法通过拼接多个参考标记块来扩展这一设计 [ Wei et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Mou et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ]。 其他研究探讨了参考图像与空间布局、掩码和姿态的组合 [ Xiao et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Mou et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025a ; She et al., 2026 ]。

paragraphs.en: Most of these methods use a shared attention context for the reference and target tokens. Thus, the token count grows with the number and resolution of references, while the model must learn which reference should control each target instance. This can cause attribute–subject misassociation and appearance confusion as the number of references increases [ Chen et al., 2026a ; Oshima et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ] . StructGen reduces this ambiguity by assigning explicit identifiers to references and their relations [ Peng et al., 2026 ] , but the reference tokens still form a shared attention context. RefRoute instead explicitly binds each reference to its designated target region and restricts unnecessary interactions via condition and attention routing.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法大多为参考标记和目标标记使用共享的注意力上下文。 因此，随着参考项的数量和分辨率增加，标记数量也会随之增长，同时模型必须学会由哪个参考项来控制每个目标实例。 随着参考项数量的增加，这可能导致属性与主体之间的错误关联以及外观混淆 [ Chen et al., 2026a ; Oshima et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ]。 StructGen 通过为参考项及其关系分配明确的标识符来减少这种模糊性 [ Peng et al., 2026 ]，但参考标记仍然构成一个共享的注意力上下文。 相比之下，RefRoute 将每个参考项明确绑定到其指定的目标区域，并通过条件路由和注意力路由限制不必要的交互。

paragraphs.en: Efficient Conditioning and Diffusion Acceleration. Several works reduce the cost of processing visual conditions. OminiControl2 [ Tan et al., 2026 ] uses compact condition representations and reuses condition features with asymmetric attention, while other methods also study efficient conditional processing [ Liu et al., 2025 ] . A separate line of work reduces the number of denoising evaluations through progressive distillation, consistency training, and distribution matching [ Salimans & Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2026 ] . These approaches address condition processing or sampling cost, but do not specifically address how the conditioning cost scales with a large number of appearance references. RefRoute focuses on this many-reference scaling problem through fixed-size per-reference representations and spatially restricted interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 高效条件化与扩散加速。 多项研究降低了视觉条件处理的成本。 OminiControl2 [ Tan et al., 2026 ] 使用紧凑的条件表示，并通过非对称注意力复用条件特征，而其他方法也研究了高效的条件处理 [ Liu et al., 2025 ]。 另一条独立的研究路线通过渐进式蒸馏、一致性训练和分布匹配来减少去噪评估的次数 [ Salimans & Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2026 ]。 这些方法解决了条件处理或采样成本的问题，但并未专门探讨条件化成本如何随着大量外观参考数量的增加而扩展。 RefRoute 通过为每个参考使用固定大小的表示以及空间受限的交互，专注于解决这一多参考扩展问题。

paragraphs.en: Reference Datasets and Benchmarks. Existing benchmarks have expanded from single-subject personalization to multi-reference and long-context generation. DreamBench [ Ruiz et al., 2023 ] evaluates subject preservation and prompt alignment, while DreamBench++ [ Peng et al., 2025 ] improves evaluation with human judgments. OmniContext [ Wu et al., 2026 ] evaluates in-context generation with multi-references, MultiRef [ Chen et al., 2025b ] combines real and synthetic multi-condition cases, and MICo-Bench [ Wei et al., 2026 ] evaluates multi-image composition with a reference-aware VLM metric. More recent benchmarks increase the number and diversity of references, including MacroBench [ Chen et al., 2026a ] , MultiBanana [ Oshima et al., 2026 ] , and StructGen Bench [ Peng et al., 2026 ] . Other works further study multi-human identity preservation and reference association [ Borse et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ] .

Let 𝐳 0 \mathbf{z}_{0} denote the clean target latent and 𝐳 t = ( 1 − t ) ​ 𝐳 0 + t ​ ϵ \mathbf{z}_{t}=(1-t)\mathbf{z}_{0}+t\bm{\epsilon} its noisy state at timestep t t , where ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , 𝐈 ) \bm{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},\mathbf{I}) . paragraphs.en: The mask first separates the reference streams: reference queries can attend to their own reference tokens, text tokens, and spatial condition tokens, but cannot attend to noisy target tokens or other references. paragraphs.en: Strictly blocking reference information outside the assigned regions can limit effects that extend beyond object boundaries, such as shadows, illumination, and contact. All tokens of the selected reference remain accessible, while connections to the other references are blocked. This selection operates at the reference level rather than the individual-token level. Together, these rules maintain explicit reference–region correspondence while permitting limited reference influence outside the assigned regions.

paragraphs.en: Overall Training. We train RefRoute in two stages. In Stage 1, we pretrain the Pixel Residual Compressor using the reconstruction and subject-driven generation tasks described in Section 3.2 . paragraphs.en: Existing multi-reference datasets [ Ye et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ] provide broad task coverage, but MICo [ Wei et al., 2026 ] , for example, has three limitations: 89.2% of MICo-Bench cases have at most five references, references lack instance-level spatial annotations, and human references often mismatch the target identity. RefRoute-Data provides per-instance references, boxes, and masks for 20k object scenes (143k instances) and 1k human scenes (Appendix A.1 ); its mean reference–target ArcFace similarity is 0.53, versus 0.19 for the MICo-150K human subset.

paragraphs.en: Experimental Setup. RefRoute is built on FLUX.2-Klein-9B, and our evaluations use 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 outputs in BF16. We evaluate on two complementary benchmarks: MICo-Bench [ Wei et al., 2026 ] , where 89.2% of 897 cases contain two to five references, and our ManyRef100, comprising 100 cases (30 Human, 30 Object, and 40 Mixed) with 10–17 references and instance-level spatial annotations. We measure generation quality using Weighted-Ref-VIEScore, which combines reference fidelity, semantic consistency, and perceptual quality. Data construction, model configurations, and evaluation protocols are detailed in Appendices A.1 and A.3 .

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Comparison. Figure 1 demonstrates many-reference generation with RefRoute, combining 13 references into a coherent scene while preserving facial identity and clothing patterns. The highlighted details include leopard-print shoes, a gingham dress, and a pendant, illustrating the retention of fine-grained appearance cues alongside correct reference–subject associations. Figure 3 presents qualitative comparisons on MICo-Bench. In the first row, RefRoute more faithfully preserves the woman’s facial identity, the structure of her top, and the background. In comparison, Qwen-MICo and Gemini alter the referenced top, while Qwen-MICo and FLUX.2-Klein-9B show discrepancies in facial identity. paragraphs.en: Restricting reference access to assigned regions can limit interactions with the surrounding scene, such as shadows and reflections. Our dynamic top-K (empirically set K=1) mechanism allows each target query outside these regions to attend to the highest-ranked reference, while retaining access to all tokens of that reference. We compare this mechanism with a strict spatial mask that blocks reference access outside assigned regions. The qualitative comparison in Figure 5 examines whether dynamic selection improves reference–environment interactions while preserving reference appearance. With the strict mask, the man appears to float above the ground, whereas dynamic routing preserves contact between his feet and the ground.

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Our current study focuses on many-reference image conditioning, where the conditioning inputs are visual references. Although RefRoute substantially reduces the representation and attention costs associated with increasing numbers of reference images, we do not investigate settings that involve long text conditioning, such as detailed textual descriptions or combinations of long text prompts with many visual references. Such settings introduce additional challenges in representing and routing long-range semantic information, which are beyond the scope of the current framework. Extending RefRoute to jointly handle large numbers of visual references and long textual conditions is an interesting direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: We presented RefRoute , a framework for scalable many-reference image generation that addresses both reference representation cost and attention overhead. Compact residual conditioning preserves fine-grained appearance cues within a reduced token budget, while condition and attention routing spatially align references with their target regions and suppress unnecessary cross-reference interactions. We further introduced RefRoute-Data and ManyRef100 to enable training and systematic evaluation in the many-reference regime. Experiments demonstrate substantially improved composition quality on ManyRef100 and more favorable inference-cost scaling as the number of references increases. At the same time, the lower performance on the predominantly few-reference MICo-Bench highlights the challenge of maintaining strong generation quality across different reference-count regimes. Overall, our results show that compact reference representations and spatially structured attention provide complementary mechanisms for scaling multi-reference generation, and suggest a broader direction toward conditioning architectures whose computational capacity adapts to the complexity of the desired scene.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RefRoute，一个用于可扩展的多参考图像生成的框架，该框架同时解决了参考表示成本和注意力开销问题。 紧凑的残差条件化在有限的令牌预算内保留了精细的外观线索，而条件和注意力路由则将参考与目标区域在空间上对齐，并抑制不必要的跨参考交互。 我们进一步引入了 RefRoute-Data 和 ManyRef100，以支持多参考场景下的训练和系统性评估。 实验表明，ManyRef100 上的构图质量得到了显著提升，并且随着参考数量增加，推理成本的扩展表现也更优。 与此同时，在主要涉及少量参考的 MICo-Bench 上性能较低，凸显了在不同参考数量场景下保持强生成质量的挑战。 总体而言，我们的结果表明，紧凑的参考表示和结构化空间注意力为多参考生成的扩展提供了互补机制，并指向了一个更广泛的方向：构建计算能力能够适应目标场景复杂度的条件化架构。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools in three ways. (1) Synthetic data: the target images and part of the references in RefRoute-Data and ManyRef100 were synthesized with GPT, HiDream-I1-Full, FLUX.2-klein-4B, and InfiniteYou (Appendix A.1 ). (2) Data filtering: vision-language models (Qwen3-VL and GPT-based judges) were used to verify, relabel, and screen generated samples during data construction (Appendix A.1 ). (3) Evaluation: generation quality is scored with Weighted-Ref-VIEScore, which relies on multimodal LLM judges (GPT-5.4 for semantic consistency and perceptual quality, and Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct for the reference weights; Appendix A.3 ). In addition, we used generative AI tools to draft parts of this paper and to edit it for readability. The research questions, method design, implementation, and interpretation of results are the authors’ own. Synthesized and filtered images were retained only after the automatic detection, face-matching, and geometric and semantic checks described in Appendix A.1 , and all AI-assisted text was checked by the authors against the experimental records. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, or artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

paragraphs.en: We provide detailed descriptions of the RefRoute architecture, compact residual conditioning, condition and attention routing, training procedure, and distillation strategy in the paper and supplementary material. We also report the implementation details, model configurations, computational cost measurements, and evaluation protocols used in our experiments. The construction and evaluation protocols of RefRoute-Data and ManyRef100 are described in detail to facilitate independent evaluation of high-cardinality multi-reference generation. We will release the source code, model configurations, data-generation and evaluation scripts, and the relevant dataset metadata upon publication, subject to the licensing and redistribution requirements of the underlying data and pretrained models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在论文和补充材料中详细描述了 RefRoute 架构、紧凑残差条件化、条件与注意力路由、训练流程以及蒸馏策略。 我们还报告了实验中使用的实现细节、模型配置、计算成本测量结果以及评估协议。 我们详细描述了 RefRoute-Data 和 ManyRef100 的构建与评估协议，以便对高基数多参考生成进行独立评估。 在发表时，我们将发布源代码、模型配置、数据生成与评估脚本以及相关数据集元数据，但需遵循底层数据和预训练模型的许可及再分发要求。

paragraphs.en: Many-reference generation requires associating each reference with its corresponding subject in a composed scene. We construct RefRoute-Data for training and ManyRef100 for evaluation. Each training record pairs a target image and scene description with per-instance references, bounding boxes, and masks, providing explicit reference-to-instance correspondence.
paragraphs.zh: 多参考生成需要将每个参考与其在合成场景中的对应主体关联起来。 我们构建 RefRoute-Data 用于训练，以及 ManyRef100 用于评估。 每条训练记录都将一个目标图像和场景描述与每个实例的参考、边界框和掩码配对，从而提供明确的参考到实例的对应关系。

These totals describe the constructed data; the subset used for training depends on the checkpoint configuration. Retained object instances cover the requested inventory rather than all visible objects, and exported human references may contain identity uncertainty.

paragraphs.en: We use separate object and human branches within a shared four-stage pipeline (Figure 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个共享的四阶段流程（图 6）中使用了独立的目标物和人类分支。

paragraphs.en: Prompt generation. For objects, we sample five to ten categories from an LVIS-derived vocabulary and compose scene descriptions. For humans, we specify scenes with two to eight people, including their attributes and poses.
paragraphs.zh: 提示生成。 对于物体，我们从源自 LVIS 的词汇表中采样五到十个类别，并组合成场景描述。 对于人物，我们指定包含两到八个人的场景，包括他们的属性和姿势。

sents.zh: 提示生成。

sents.en: For humans, we specify scenes with two to eight people, including their attributes and poses.
sents.zh: 对于人物，我们指定包含两到八个人的场景，包括他们的属性和姿势。

paragraphs.en: Target synthesis. We generate object scenes with HiDream-I1-Full and human scenes with GPT at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution. Human scenes use input identity images for two to four people and text-only conditioning for five to eight people.
paragraphs.zh: 目标合成。 我们使用 HiDream-I1-Full 生成物体场景，使用 GPT 生成人物场景，分辨率为 1024 × 1024。 人物场景对于两到四人使用身份输入图像，对于五到八人则仅使用文本条件。

paragraphs.en: Instance annotation. For objects, GroundingDINO localizes the requested categories, and one-to-one assignment associates detections with the inventory. paragraphs.zh: 实例标注。 对于物体，GroundingDINO 会定位所请求的类别，并通过一对一分配将检测结果与库存关联起来。 对于人类，人物检测、姿态估计和人脸匹配会将个体与其空间标注及可用的身份图像关联起来。 SAM 会在两个分支中生成实例掩码。

paragraphs.en: Verification and reference construction. We filter or relabel unreliable object instances using geometric and semantic checks, then generate studio-style references from target crops with FLUX.2-klein-4B, retaining the crops when generation fails. For humans, we reuse an input identity image when its ArcFace cosine similarity to the matched target face is at least 0.50; otherwise, a reference may be synthesized from the target face.
paragraphs.zh: 验证与参考构建。 我们通过几何和语义检查过滤或重新标记不可靠的对象实例，然后使用 FLUX.2-klein-4B 从目标裁剪图像生成工作室风格的参考图像；若生成失败，则保留原始裁剪图像。 对于人类对象，当其 ArcFace 余弦相似度与匹配的目标面部至少为 0.50 时，我们重复使用输入的识别图像；否则，可以从目标面部合成参考图像。

paragraphs.en: We construct ManyRef100 to evaluate composition with larger reference sets across human, object, and mixed scenes. It contains 100 cases: 30 Human, 30 Object, and 40 Mixed, each with 10–17 references and explicit reference-to-instance spatial assignments. Object references derive from an earlier target version, while human references are rerendered. The benchmark therefore supports controlled evaluation of many-subject composition; generalization from independently photographed references remains outside its scope. Representative cases are provided in Appendix A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建 ManyRef100，用于评估在包含人类、物体和混合场景的更大参考集中进行组合的能力。 它包含 100 个案例：30 个人类场景、30 个物体场景和 40 个混合场景，每个案例包含 10–17 个参考，并明确指定了参考与实例之间的空间对应关系。 物体参考源自早期的目标版本，而人类参考则经过重新渲染生成。 因此，该基准支持对多主体组合的受控评估；但从独立拍摄的参考中实现泛化仍不在其研究范围内。 代表性案例见附录 A.2。

paragraphs.en: Throughout the paper, FLUX.2-Klein-9B refers to the FLUX.2 [klein] 9B model family, and the number of sampling steps identifies the checkpoint. Four-step results use the step-distilled FLUX.2-Klein-9B checkpoint, and 50-step results use the undistilled FLUX.2-Klein-Base-9B checkpoint. Both checkpoints share the same architecture and parameter count. This applies to Figure 1 , Figure 4 , and all latency and speedup comparisons.

paragraphs.en: The pixel residual encoder uses 6 3 × 3 3\times 3 stride- 2 2 convolutions with GroupNorm and SiLU activations, for a total downsampling factor of 2 6 2^{6} . Its output is aligned with the low-resolution reference grid, flattened, and processed by 2 lightweight spatial self-attention blocks. A zero-initialized linear projection maps the resulting features into the DiT hidden space, where they are added to the projected low-resolution latent features.
paragraphs.zh: 像素残差编码器使用 6 个 3×3、步长为 2 的卷积层，并配合 GroupNorm 和 SiLU 激活函数，总下采样倍数为 2⁶。 其输出与低分辨率参考网格对齐，随后被展平，并由 2 个轻量级空间自注意力模块处理。 一个零初始化的线性投影将得到的特征映射到 DiT 隐藏空间中，并与投影后的低分辨率潜在特征相加。

paragraphs.en: We implement the OminiControl2 reference-branch mechanism [ Tan et al., 2026 ] on the same backbone, using native-resolution references (4096 tokens per reference). Our representation uses 256 tokens per reference with pixel residuals. The OminiControl2 condition adapter is untrained; compact encoding and cross-step reuse are disabled. The results characterize mechanism cost rather than the complete trained system. Reference-branch topology also differs, so the timing gap is not attributed solely to token count.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在相同的骨干网络上实现了 OminiControl2 参考分支机制 [Tan et al., 2026]，并使用原生分辨率的参考（每个参考 4096 个标记）。 我们的表示方法每个参考使用 256 个标记，并包含像素残差。 OminiControl2 条件适配器未经训练；紧凑编码和跨步重用功能均已禁用。 这些结果反映的是机制本身的成本，而非完整的训练后系统。 参考分支的拓扑结构也存在差异，因此时间延迟并非完全由标记数量引起。
